Question: A rectangular box \(P\) has distinct edge lengths \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c.\) The sum of the lengths of all \(12\) edges of \(P\) is \(13,\) the sum of the areas of all \(6\) faces of \(P\) is \(\tfrac{11}{2},\) and the volume of \(P\) is \(\tfrac{1}{2}.\) What is the length of the longest interior diagonal connecting two vertices of \(P?\)
